_comment: Named release-gate exemptions, docs/RELEASE-POLICY.md#named-release-gate-exemption. Each case may be NOT COVERED in a stable release gate only with a detail that starts with its reason. Adding one needs the project owner's written approval.

exemptions.case: links-survey: scan_deviation measures the top face of a floor staged on a scanned floor
exemptions.why: the release runner's only point cloud is sparse (about one point per square metre)

exemptions.case: design options: list reports option sets, options and the primary
exemptions.reason_prefix: rac_advanced_sample_project (the only sample of this year) carries no design options
exemptions.why: Revit's API cannot create design options and Autodesk's only 2023 sample has none; 2024-2027 measure it

exemptions.case: cde_cloud issues: issues_list reads the issues with their subtypes and names what it could not read
exemptions.reason_prefix: no ACC test project named: set HORIZUN_PROBE_ACC_PROJECT_ID to a test project GUID
exemptions.why: the owner accepted missing ACC test-project coverage; configured runners must execute the probe, and failures remain failures

exemptions.case: cde_cloud issues: an issue_create dry run rehearses with a token or refuses with the reason, and creates nothing
exemptions.reason_prefix: no ACC test project named: set HORIZUN_PROBE_ACC_PROJECT_ID to a test project GUID
exemptions.why: the owner accepted missing ACC test-project coverage; configured runners must execute the probe, and failures remain failures

exemptions.case: cde_cloud issues: issue_create applies, reads the issue back and a keyed retry does not duplicate it
